To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

hypertonic stress induces a rapid increase of membrane conductance and a regulatory volume increase in rat hepatocytes, both of which are mediated by all three subunits (α, β, and γ) of the epithelial sodium channel.

all three subunit isoforms of the epithelial sodium channel are functionally related and required for the hypertonicity-activated Na+ current and for regulatory volume increase (i.e., cell swelling) in rat hepatocyte.
all three subunit isoforms of the epithelial sodium channel (ENaCs) contribute to regulatory volume increase in rat hepatocytes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the functional relationship of the epithelial sodium channel (ENaCs) and the hypertonicity-inducing cation channel (HIICC) in rat liver cells.
the regulation of the epithelial sodium channel (ENaCs).
the functional relation of the ENaCs and the hypertonicity-activated cation channel in rat hepatocytes, which was tested with specific siRNA constructs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
ENaC is a key regulator of RVI and HIC activation in rat hepatocyte.
the ENaC is the molecular basis of HICC.
all three rENaC subunits are necessary for the function of the HICC in rat hepatocytes, but not sufficient.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ENaC is the major HICC of rat hepatocytes.
the three subunits of ENaC are not only involved in the regulation of cell volume but also in the regulation of blood pressure and in cell migration.   1.
all three subunit of the epithelial sodium channel are necessary for hypertonicity-induced RVI and activation of the hypertonicity induced cation channel in rat hepatocytes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the three subunits of epithelial Na+ channels are functionally involved in the regulation of cell volume in rat hepatocytes.
the ENaC is a major component of the RVI pathway and that the ENaCs in the hepatocyte plasma membrane are activated by hypertonicity.
all three subunit of ENaC are necessary to activate the HICC and the RVI.
